name: causal_conv1d_update
description: Single-step or short-sequence causal conv state update with signature causal_conv1d_update(x, conv_state, weight, bias=None, activation='silu'). x is [batch, dim] when seqlen==1 or [batch, dim, seqlen] otherwise; conv_state is [batch, dim, state_len] and weight is [dim, width]. Concatenate the cached state and x along time, compute the width-wide causal convolution for each output position, optionally add bias and apply SiLU, and return (out, new_conv_state): out is newly allocated with x's shape, and new_conv_state is newly allocated with shape [batch, dim, state_len] holding the trailing state_len values. The native implementation does not modify conv_state or the other inputs. The reference builds and returns an updated clone. The suite exercises bfloat16 with width 3/4, state_len=width-1, seqlen 1 and 4.
